ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1795518580000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between the Sun and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.
